title: Seeker Summer: quests and badges through Aug 30
detail: Part of Seeker Season 2. Runs July 7 - Aug 30, 2026: four two-week rounds, four featured apps each, two quests per app. Each quest earns a badge kept in the dApp Store and Seed Vault Wallet's Activity Tracking tab. Open the Seeker Summer hub, install a featured app, complete both quests. Apps rotate each round.

title: Activity Tracking: the three categories Seeker measures
detail: Onchain Activity uses a rolling 30-day view (refreshes daily); dApp Exploration and Daily Use are shown by week, Mon-Sun (update every 20-30 min). Needs Usage & Diagnostics on in Settings > Solana Mobile plus your Genesis Token connected, or the Activity tab won't appear. No SKR payout formula is published.

title: Stake SKR for variable staking rewards
detail: Rewards come from SKR inflation and compound automatically. The rate is variable - official pages showed conflicting figures, so read the live rate on the site. Stake from your Seeker in Seed Vault Wallet; delegation is automatic. Unstaking takes a 48h cooldown that earns nothing, then a manual withdrawal.

title: Genesis Token: your Seeker's onchain proof of ownership
detail: Soulbound NFT minted once per Seeker into your Seed Vault Wallet primary account; proves device ownership and gates Activity Tracking. Not automatic: during Seed Vault setup you pick a Seeker ID (.skr, permanent) and link the token via on-screen prompts. Solana Mobile doesn't publish a list of what it unlocks.

title: 20% off a new Seeker plus a $50 Collector Crypt rip
detail: New buyers only; existing owners can't claim. Solana Mobile: 20% off a Seeker plus a free $50 gacha spin for the first 5,000 buyers with code CARDS20. Enter it at checkout on store.solanamobile.com and pay by Solana Pay in USDC, USDT, PYUSD or SKR; the rip goes to that wallet. Ends Aug 30 or at 5,000 buyers.

title: 20% fitness XP boost for Seeker owners
detail: A 20% boost on fitness XP - the points earned for real, verifiable activity in Moonwalk games - through January 1, 2027. Game-creation and referral XP are excluded; 20% is the stated maximum. New users sign up in the app with the Seeker Genesis Token; existing users link their Seeker wallet via Matrica.

title: .skr domain gives 7% boosts; 10k SKR staked unlocks a Guardian
detail: Hold a .skr domain and Cryptara Conquest grants 7% off in-game purchases, 7% increased movement speed and 7% increased maximum health. Connect the wallet holding the domain to activate the boosts. Separately, players staking 10,000+ SKR can claim the Seeker Toly Guardian companion free. No end date announced.

title: Seeker theme and badge for SKR holders, 10% off paying in SKR
detail: Holding SKR unlocks a free SEEKER phone-shell theme (marked holders only) and a Holds $SKR badge in Snake OS. Market checkout separately offers 10% off when you pay in SKR instead of SOL - the discount is for paying in SKR, not just holding it. No qualifying SKR threshold is published.

title: Pay for hotel bookings with SKR
detail: Solana Mobile says Nomadz "switched on SKR payments for hotel bookings, so you can pay for a stay straight with SKR from your wallet." Install Nomadz from the Solana dApp Store, search for a stay and choose SKR at checkout. It is a payment option, not a discount. No end date stated.

title: Builder Grants: apply any time, no deadline (developers)
detail: For developers, not a consumer perk. Solana Mobile funds mobile-first Solana dApps and applications are always open - "you can apply with any grant idea at any time." Selected teams typically receive a milestones-based grant; no amount is published. Apply via the form at solanamobile.com/grants.
